error: P2-32 complete-record sampling requires a padding mask
rootCause: P2-32 StructuredPlanCompleteRecordCorpus exposes sample_masked_batch, but the shared runner _training_step only recognizes the older CompleteRecordTokenCorpus class and therefore called the intentionally-disabled sample_batch method.
recoveryPolicy: Only an output directory containing no checkpoints and no metrics event other than run_started may be automatically removed before the authorized retry.
fix: Use a P2-32-specific mask-aware training step that calls sample_masked_batch directly while preserving the verified sampler and target-weight semantics.
